title: Extra 50% off Marked Price Warehouse Sale @ David Jones
body:
Deal: Extra 50% off Marked Price Warehouse Sale @ David Jones

[Big L] If you like Frank Green, there's a lot of stuff there. There were some RM Williams boots for $245, but unsurprisingly they've sold out. I'm not sure of the value of RM Williams jeans, but they were around $80
The site search sucks, so if you're looking for something specific, try a few different ways to find it.
The 18,000 items include each size and colour, so don't be surprised when you search that it shows '40 products', but displays 10.
I didn't read the post properly, so be aware that the price is 50 - 70% off what is already marked down.
[Sydney11] I didn't read the post properly, so be aware that the price is 50 - 70% off what is already marked down.
Yes this is most important. I had written it above under IMPORTANT. The price shown while shopping in red or black is not the final price. When you add to the shopping basket to checkout, the price will auto slash again by 50% or more (i have seen 70%). i.e a further 50%-70% discount on an already discounted item.

[Tanvry] tbh I think this just goes to show how much these "luxury" designer brands make off us, discount and an extra 50% off and with gift cards and they'll likely still profit
[illusion99] Sales are either funded by the manufacturer (brand), the retailer or both. Retailers are likely to take a loss just to clear out low selling stock. I’m guessing this sale is mainly funded by David jones not the luxury brand itself given the sale is across multiple brands
[Merlict] Yeah the retailer sure as hell doesn't have 70%+ margins on designer brands
[illusion99] Average retailer margin on luxury brands is around 40% as a starting point
[Big L] @illusion99: Depends what you're calling a luxury brand
[Antikythera] most times when i shop similar sales, I make one purchase but get several deliveries from DJ stores all over the country.
lots of sizes are sold out. the retailer is clearing out unpopular sizes and styles from all of their stores.
I usually find several work shirts when David Jones does extra 60% off or in this case extra 50% off. I'm not too fussy on style or brand.
today I got 9 shirts at an average price just under $35
